hero.title: A revolutionary healthcare ecosystem
hero.description: Holarc is one connected platform where doctors run their entire practice and patients own their entire 360Â° health story â€” from voice-recorded consultations and AI summaries, to video-verified medication adherence rewards, cross-specialist Round Tables, hospital admissions, prescriptions, billing, and a unified care calendar.

features.transcribedDescription: Voice transcribed in real time. AI extracts diagnoses, prescriptions and follow-up tasks automatically.

features.aiAssistantDescription: Patient history summaries Â· medication conflict alerts Â· imaging analysis Â· auto-generated documents.

patientBenefits.sectionDescription: Holarc gives you a complete 360-degree view of your health profileâ€”every consultation, prescription, and clinical note from every provider, unified in one place and entirely under your control.

patientBenefits.benefit2Description: Invite specialists, GPs, and other providers to collaborate on your care with your full consent.
patientBenefits.benefit3Description: Decide exactly which doctors see your records. Grant or revoke access anytime with granular permissions.
patientBenefits.benefit4Description: All your healthcare appointments from every provider in one calendarâ€”never miss a follow-up.

providerBenefits.sectionDescription: When patients grant you access, you see everythingâ€”their complete history across all providers. Make better decisions with better information.
providerBenefits.benefit1Description: Get comprehensive patient history summaries and medication conflict alerts before every consultation.

providerBenefits.benefit3Description: Voice-to-text notes, auto-populated templates, and AI summaries save hours of administrative work.
providerBenefits.benefit4Description: Access complete patient history across all their providersâ€”make informed decisions with the full picture.

providerBenefits.benefit6Description: Hospitals receive inbound emergencies with prefilled patient summaries, manage admissions, and coordinate with referring doctors in real time.
